Name: PPJA Icon Pack for Better Artisan Goods Icons
Author: Pathoschild
TagLine: A content pack for Better Artisan Goods Icons that is meant to pair with the PPJA collection. Includes optional download for default crops & Stardrops Crop as well.
Description:
![](https://i.imgur.com/FRWZNCt.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/Eqdpuvd.png)

For All Downloads:
- Latest version of [SMAPI 3.0+
](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI)- Latest version of [Better Artisan Good Icons

](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080)*Recommended* For JsonAssets Icons:
- [Fruits and Veggies for JsonAssets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1598/?)
-[Mizu's Flowers](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2028)
- [More Trees
](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1671)
*Optional*
- [Stardrops Crops](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4661) by [IVanillinI
](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/57165757)
![](https://i.imgur.com/kLbxt2U.png)﻿

- Drag + Drop the extracted folder into /Mods 

![](https://i.imgur.com/MnkF0nq.png)

- Delete the pack from /Mods
